implementing_agency: Directorate of Industries and Commerce (DIC Kerala)

women_sc_st_young.note: Subsidy rate increases to 25% (up to ₹40 Lakh) for enterprises owned by Women, SC/ST, Young Entrepreneurs (under 45), or Ex-servicemen.

thrust_sectors.note: Priority thrust sectors (food processing, electronics, green tech, biotechnology) receive up to 30% capital assistance capped at ₹45 Lakh.

effective_interest_rate_note: Comprehensive capital investment grant credited directly against fixed assets (land, factory building, plant, and machinery).
eligibility_human: Micro, Small, and Medium manufacturing enterprises in Kerala registered with Udyam Registration that have acquired building and machinery assets.

documents_required.name: Factory Building Completion Certificate and Valuation

pros: Covers up to 30% or ₹45 Lakh on fixed capital investment for sunrise and thrust industries.
Includes specialized technology absorption and modern quality certification subsidies up to ₹5 Lakh.
Supports modernizing and diversifying existing units.
cons: Service and trading businesses are entirely excluded.
Strict physical inspection and documentation of fixed capital expenditure.
application_steps: Apply for In-Principle Registration prior to establishing fixed assets or within 1 year of production.
Submit final claim on Kerala MSME portal with bills and valuation.
Physical verification by General Manager, DIC.
State Level Committee sanctions subsidy for direct bank transfer.

name: NORKA Department Project for Returned Emigrants (NDPREM)
ministry: Non-Resident Keralites Affairs (NORKA), Govt of Kerala

prompt_repayment.note: A 3% interest subvention is offered for the first 4 years provided the borrower makes timely, regular EMI repayments.

effective_interest_rate_note: Bank loan interest rate is discounted by 3% through regular state interest subvention, alongside a 15% capital seed subsidy.
eligibility_human: Returned Kerala emigrants who have worked overseas for a minimum period of 2 years and have settled permanently back in Kerala to start a self-employment venture.

documents_required.name: Passport with Emigration Clearance and Visa Page showing 2-year overseas work

pros: 15% capital subsidy capped at ₹4.5 Lakh helps returned emigrants re-integrate into the local economy.
Covers wide range of businesses: transport services, retail outlets, agriculture, and small factories.
Orientation and project vetting camps organized jointly with major lenders.
cons: Strict requirement of minimum 2 continuous years abroad.
If the bank loan turns into an NPA, the interest subvention is cancelled retroactively.
application_steps: Register profile on NORKA Roots online web portal.
Submit DPR and passport documents verifying overseas employment tenure.
Attend screening interview; NORKA issues sponsorship letter to preferred bank branch.
Bank disburses loan; NORKA Roots deposits capital subsidy directly to bank loan account.

name: West Bengal Bhabishyat Credit Card Scheme (WBBCCS)
ministry: Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Govt of West Bengal
implementing_agency: Directorate of MSME / DIC West Bengal

credit_guarantee.note: Government of West Bengal provides up to 85% credit guarantee cover, eliminating third-party guarantee or collateral burdens.

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard commercial bank rates apply. State government provides 10% upfront margin money grant (max ₹25,000) and covers default risks through state guarantee.
eligibility_human: Youth residing in West Bengal for at least 10 years aged 18 to 45 who are setting up a new income-generating manufacturing, service, or trading business. Only one person per family is eligible.

documents_required.name: Proof of 10-year West Bengal Residence (Voter Card / Residential Certificate)

pros: Enables collateral-free credit up to ₹5 Lakh backed by state credit guarantee.
10% state margin money contribution (up to ₹25,000) reduces borrower upfront burden to zero or nominal 5%.
Widely mobilized during grassroots Duare Sarkar outreach camps.
cons: Restricted strictly to one member per household.
Limited maximum ticket size (₹5 Lakh), limiting capital-heavy production plants.
application_steps: Apply online on Bhabishyat Credit Card portal or submit during Duare Sarkar camps.
Applications scrutinized by Block Development Officer (BDO) / Municipal Commissioner.
Forwarded digitally to commercial bank branch for loan sanction.
State margin money subsidy disbursed directly into the loan account.

name: Bangla Swanirbhar Karmasansthan Prakalpa (BSKP)
ministry: Department of Self-Help Group & Self-Employment, Govt of West Bengal
implementing_agency: Society for Employment of Unemployed Youths / DIC

group_ventures.note: For group enterprises (cluster or group of 5+ individuals), project cost is supported up to ₹10 Lakh with a 30% government subsidy (max ₹1.5 Lakh).

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard institutional lending rates apply. Government provides 20% to 30% non-repayable margin money grant to extinguish principal balance.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of West Bengal aged 18 to 45 registered with an employment exchange or belonging to vulnerable economic strata with annual family income below ₹1,80,000.

documents_required.name: Proof of Age (Madhyamik Admit / Birth Certificate)

pros: Substantial 20% upfront government grant (up to ₹1 Lakh individual, ₹1.5 Lakh group).
Borrower contributes only 5% of project cost as owner equity.
Covers manufacturing, repairs, food stalls, and small retail ventures.
cons: Family annual income threshold capped at ₹1.80 Lakh.
Requires manual offline processing through local BDO or Municipal Executive Officers.
application_steps: Collect and submit BSKP form at local BDO office or municipal corporation.
Screening committee verifies family income and local residence.
Proposal recommended to service area commercial bank branch.
Bank disburses loan and claims government margin money subsidy.

name: Punjab Industrial and Business Development Capital Subsidy
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt of Punjab

women_and_sc.note: SC, ST, and Women-owned MSMEs receive an extra 5% capital subsidy, up to ₹2.5 Crore.

interest_subvention.note: 5% interest subvention for 7 years on term loans for Micro and Small Enterprises up to ₹10 Lakh per year.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 5% annual interest subvention on term loans for up to 7 years, combined with an upfront Fixed Capital Investment (FCI) subsidy.
eligibility_human: Micro, Small, and Medium manufacturing enterprises setting up greenfield units or undertaking substantial expansion in designated industrial zones in Punjab.

documents_required.name: Invest Punjab Single Window In-Principle Approval
Detailed Project Report & CA Valuation Certificate
Term Loan Sanction and Disbursement Proof

pros: Substantial capital subsidy up to ₹2 Crore on plant and machinery.
5% interest subvention for 7 straight years dramatically reduces loan amortizations.
Exemption from electricity duty for 7 to 10 years depending on category zone.
cons: Strictly excludes traditional trading and commercial service agencies.
Incentive claims require rigorous audits and compliance with state labor and environmental laws.
application_steps: Register project via Invest Punjab single window business portal.
Complete construction and deploy plant machinery within approved timeline.
File common application form for fiscal incentives within 6 months of commercial run.
Field appraisal by General Manager DIC and state treasury subsidy release.

name: Haryana Enterprise Promotion Policy (HEEP) Capital Subsidy
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt of Haryana

backward_blocks_c_and_d.note: Units established in Category 'C' and 'D' industrially backward blocks receive a 25% capital investment subsidy up to ₹50 Lakh, plus 6% interest subvention up to ₹20 Lakh/year.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 5% to 6% interest subsidy for 5 to 7 years on term loans, combined with an upfront Fixed Capital Investment subsidy.
eligibility_human: Micro and Small enterprises setting up manufacturing operations in Haryana, particularly within Category B, C, and D blocks with valid Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM) and Udyam Registration.

documents_required.name: CA Certified Plant & Machinery Expenditure Invoices
Commercial Bank Term Loan Sanction Letter

pros: Up to ₹50 Lakh capital subsidy in less industrialized areas (C and D blocks).
Up to 6% interest subsidy for 7 years on term loans.
Additional testing equipment assistance covering 75% of lab setup costs up to ₹50 Lakh.
cons: Highly restricted benefits for Category 'A' blocks (Gurugram/Faridabad).
Mandatory requirement of employing minimum 50% Haryana domicile labor.
application_steps: Obtain Haryana Udhyam Memorandum (HUM) registration online.
Execute project construction and install machinery.
File claim online via Invest Haryana portal within 3 months of starting commercial activity.
Verification by Joint Director of District MSME Centre and direct fund credit.

name: Chief Minister’s Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan (CMAAA)
ministry: Industries, Commerce and Public Enterprise Department, Govt of Assam
implementing_agency: Directorate of Industries & Commerce / Assam Skill Development Mission

professional_graduates.note: Professional category (Engineering, MBBS, BDS, Agriculture, Veterinary graduates) eligible for ₹5 Lakh total assistance: ₹2.5 Lakh non-repayable grant + ₹2.5 Lakh interest-free loan.

effective_interest_rate_note: 50% of the financial assistance is a 100% non-repayable government grant. The remaining 50% is an interest-free loan repayable after a 5-year moratorium period.
eligibility_human: Permanent residents of Assam aged 28 to 40 (relaxed to 43 for SC/ST/OBC) possessing minimum educational qualification of 10th pass for general category, or professional degrees for higher tier funding. Must be registered on the Assam Employment Exchange portal.
pros: 50% pure grant assistance plus 50% interest-free state loan.
Unprecedented 5-year repayment moratorium.
Comprehensive 1-month mandatory business and technical training provided with stipend.
cons: Minimum age threshold set high at 28 years.
Applicants cannot be defaulters of any central or state bank loan.
application_steps: Register on the CMAAA online portal using Employment Exchange ID.
Submit DPR across approved sectors (tea packaging, agriculture, fabrication, tourism).
Shortlisted candidates undergo 1-month skill and enterprise training.
Grant and interest-free loan transferred in two milestone phases via DBT.

name: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana (IMSUY)
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Rajasthan
implementing_agency: Directorate of Women Empowerment / DIC Rajasthan

sc_st_women_and_shgs.note: SC, ST, and Divyang women entrepreneurs and registered Women SHG Federations receive an enhanced 30% capital subsidy (up to ₹30 Lakh for individuals and ₹1 Crore for SHG Federations).

effective_interest_rate_note: Direct back-ended capital grant (25% to 30%) credited to the bank term loan, drastically curtailing monthly principal amortization.
eligibility_human: Individual women entrepreneurs aged 18+ who are permanent residents of Rajasthan, or Self Help Group Federations looking to set up new manufacturing, service, or trading enterprises.
pros: 25% to 30% capital subsidy up to ₹1 Crore for SHG Federations and ₹25-30 Lakh for individuals.
Covers trading ventures up to ₹1 Crore, uncommon among MSME subsidy policies.
Integrated with Rajasthan SSO unified digital identification system.
cons: Strictly limited to female ownership; transfer of shares to male partners revokes subsidy.
Mandatory 3-year term deposit lock-in for backend subsidy adjustment.
application_steps: Log into Rajasthan Single Sign-On (SSO) portal and access the IMSUY application.
Submit DPR, Jan Aadhaar details, and preferred lending institution.
District Level Task Force evaluates and forwards application to bank branch.
Bank disburses term loan; Department of Women Empowerment transfers subsidy directly to the bank.

name: SWAYAM (Swatantra Yuva Udyami) Scheme
ministry: Panchayati Raj & Drinking Water Department, Govt of Odisha
effective_interest_rate_note: 100% interest subsidy provided by the state government, rendering the loan entirely interest-free. 100% credit guarantee cover is also provided.
eligibility_human: Odisha youth aged 18-35 (relaxed to 40 for SC/ST/PwD) whose family is covered under KALIA/BSKY scheme or has an annual income under ₹2 Lakh (rural) / ₹3 Lakh (urban). Must not have outstanding loans from other govt schemes.

documents_required.name: BSKY or KALIA Card / Income Certificate

pros: Complete 0% interest loan up to ₹1 Lakh with no processing fees.
Requires only 5% margin money contribution from the applicant.
Applicable for both starting a new business and expanding an existing one.
cons: Applicants with existing government business loans or bank defaults are strictly excluded.
Government employees' families are ineligible.
application_steps: Register on the SWAYAM official portal (selecting Urban/Rural).
Fill out the application form and upload UDYAM and income proofs.
Application is verified by Block Level Officer / Mission Shakti.
Approved loan is disbursed directly to the bank account without collateral.

contact_info.helpline: Contact Local BLO / Mission Shakti Office

name: Bhagwan Birsa Munda Swarojgar Yojana
ministry: Tribal Affairs & Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, MP
effective_interest_rate_note: State government provides a 5% interest subsidy on the bank loan for a maximum of 7 years, significantly reducing the effective interest rate.
eligibility_human: Scheduled Tribe (ST) youth of Madhya Pradesh aged 18 to 55 who have passed at least the 8th standard.
pros: High project cost ceiling: up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹25 Lakh for service/retail sectors.
5% continuous interest subvention for 7 years.
cons: Strictly limited to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) community.
application_steps: Apply online via the MP SAMAST portal.
Application is vetted by the Adivasi Vitt Vikas Nigam at the district level.
Forwarded to banks for loan sanctioning; interest subsidy is credited back post-disbursement.

contact_info.helpline: Contact Local Adivasi Vitt Vikas Nigam Office

name: Vishwakarma Kamgar Kalyan Yojana (Rajasthan)
ministry: Labour Department / Industries Department, Govt of Rajasthan

insurance_and_marriage.note: Includes ₹2 Lakh accident insurance, Chiranjeevi health cover, and a one-time ₹5,000 gift for newly married registered workers.

effective_interest_rate_note: 100% free physical toolkit grant transferred via DBT; no loan component.
eligibility_human: Traditional artisans (potters, weavers, cobblers, carpenters, tailors, etc.) and street vendors in Rajasthan aged 18-60. Annual family income must be below ₹2.5 Lakh.
pros: Provides direct ₹5,000 DBT assistance to purchase essential trade toolkits.
Comprehensive social security wrapper including ₹2 lakh accident insurance.
cons: Must not have received a toolkit benefit under any central scheme (like PM Vishwakarma) in the same year.
application_steps: Log into the Rajasthan SSO portal with Jan Aadhaar.
Submit application under the Vishwakarma Kamgar Kalyan Yojana linking trade details.
Labour Inspector conducts verification.
Upon approval, ₹5,000 DBT is released to the bank account and insurance policy is activated.

name: Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund (TANSEED)
ministry: MSME Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu

matching_grant_rule.note: Up to ₹10 Lakh is provided as a pure grant. Any seed support exceeding ₹10 Lakh (up to ₹50 Lakh) typically requires a matching grant raised by the startup.

effective_interest_rate_note: 100% non-dilutive equity-free grant disbursed in milestone-based tranches.
eligibility_human: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or Registered Partnership headquartered in Tamil Nadu. The entity must be less than 10 years old with less than ₹100 Cr turnover and working on innovative products (pure services excluded).
pros: Offers up to ₹50 Lakh in non-dilutive seed funding (extraordinary projects).
Provides institutional validation which aids in subsequent VC fundraising rounds.
cons: Pure service delivery businesses (Trade and Commerce) are strictly ineligible.
Highly competitive multi-stage pitch evaluation; funds are released strictly against verified development milestones.
application_steps: Ensure DPIIT and StartupTN portal registrations are active.
Submit application and business plan during the TANSEED cohort call.
Shortlisted startups undergo expert technical audit and pitch to the High-Level Committee.
Execute grant agreement and receive funds in milestone tranches.

name: Mukhya Mantri Swavlamban Yojana (MMSY)
ministry: Department of Industries, Govt of Himachal Pradesh

women_sc_st_divyang_widows.note: Capital subsidy is 30% for Women, SC, ST, and Divyang applicants, and 35% for Widows. Subsidy is calculated on plant and machinery up to ₹60 Lakh.

interest_subvention.note: A 5% interest subvention is provided on the term loan for a period of 3 years.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 5% interest reduction on commercial bank rates for the first 3 years of the term loan.
eligibility_human: Permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh aged 18 to 45 years setting up a new manufacturing, service, or commercial enterprise.
pros: Extremely high subsidy percentage for vulnerable groups (35% for widows).
Large project cost limit (up to ₹1 Crore).
Combines capital investment subsidy with interest subvention.
cons: Subsidy calculation is capped at ₹60 Lakh for plant and machinery, even if the total project cost is higher.
Strictly for greenfield (new) projects.
application_steps: Register and submit DPR online on the MMSY portal.
District Level Committee (DLC) scrutinizes and forwards the application to the selected bank.
Bank sanctions the term loan.
Subsidy is disbursed to the bank and kept in a term deposit lock-in.

name: Mukhyamantri Rojgar Srijan Yojana (MMRSY)
ministry: Scheduled Tribe, Scheduled Caste, Minority and Backward Class Welfare Department
implementing_agency: Jharkhand State Tribal Cooperative Development Corporation (JSTCDC)
effective_interest_rate_note: A highly subsidized interest rate of 6% per annum is applied to the loan amount derived after deducting the 40% government subsidy.
eligibility_human: Youth of Jharkhand aged 18 to 50 belonging to SC, ST, OBC, Minority, or Divyang categories with an annual family income not exceeding ₹5 Lakhs. No government employee in the family.
pros: Massive 40% state loan subsidy (up to ₹5 Lakh).
Low flat interest rate of 6% per annum on the remaining balance.
Loans up to ₹50,000 require zero margin money and zero guarantors.
cons: Strictly limited to SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and Divyang applicants; General category is ineligible.
Loans above ₹50,000 require 10% margin money and one guarantor (government employee or taxpayer).
application_steps: Obtain and fill the application form from the District Welfare Office or JSTCDC portal.
Attach all caste, income, and residence certificates.
Submit the physical file to the District Welfare Officer.
District Level Committee approves the loan and disburses directly.

name: Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana (VBY)
ministry: Cottage and Rural Industries Department, Govt of Gujarat
implementing_agency: District Industries Centre (DIC) / Bankable Scheme Cell

rural_and_reserved.note: Subsidy rate scales based on location and category: Urban General (20%), Rural General (25%), Urban Reserved/Women (30%), Rural Reserved/Women (40%). Blind or 40% disabled individuals get a max subsidy limit of ₹1,25,000 across all sectors.

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard bank rates apply. The government provides a back-ended margin money subsidy to reduce principal repayment.
eligibility_human: Residents of Gujarat aged 18 to 65 with a minimum educational qualification of 4th standard pass. Must possess at least 1-3 months of training or 1 year of experience in the proposed business field.
pros: Extremely low educational barrier (only 4th standard pass required).
No income limit constraint to apply.
Covers trading and business up to ₹8 Lakh.
cons: Low maximum subsidy ceiling (₹1,25,000 for industry, ₹1,00,000 for service, ₹80,000 for business).
Strict requirement for certified training or 1 year of verifiable experience.
application_steps: Register on the e-Kutir Gujarat portal.
Fill out the VBY application and upload required documents and project estimates.
DIC evaluates the application and forwards it to the selected bank.
Bank sanctions the loan and claims the subsidy, which is kept in a lock-in account.

name: Karma Sathi Prakalpa
ministry: Department of MSME and Textiles, Govt of West Bengal

capital_subsidy.note: Provides a 15% project subsidy (max ₹25,000) alongside 100% interest subvention, rendering the loan virtually interest-free.

effective_interest_rate_note: 100% interest subvention provided by the State Government, making the loan interest-free for the borrower.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of West Bengal aged 18 to 45 who have passed at least Class 8 and have an annual family income below ₹2.5 Lakh. Applicant must not have defaulted on previous loans.
pros: Provides up to ₹2 Lakh entirely interest-free.
Included 15% upfront capital subsidy (up to ₹25,000) reduces the borrowed amount.
Easily accessible through state 'Duare Sarkar' (government at doorstep) camps.
cons: Only one member per family can avail of the scheme.
Limited maximum ticket size (₹2 Lakh) restricts large-scale ventures.
application_steps: Procure the application form from the local BDO or SDO office, or during a Duare Sarkar camp.
Submit the filled form along with project viability report.
Screening committee vets the application and routes it to the cooperative bank.
Loan is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

name: Telangana Dalit Bandhu Scheme
ministry: Scheduled Castes Development Department, Govt of Telangana
implementing_agency: Telangana Scheduled Castes Co-operative Development Corporation (TSCCDC)

dalit_security_fund.note: ₹10,000 from the grant is parked in a 'Dalit Rakshana Nidhi' (Security Fund) to support the family in case of future eventualities.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% direct financial grant. No bank linkage, no loan, no repayment, and no margin money required.
eligibility_human: Scheduled Caste (SC) families residing in Telangana. The beneficiary has absolute freedom to choose any income-generating enterprise (e.g., tractors, medical shops, dairy, transport vehicles).
pros: The largest direct cash transfer scheme for SC entrepreneurship in India (₹10 Lakh free grant).
Completely bypasses the banking system, eliminating rejection due to low CIBIL scores or lack of collateral.
Beneficiaries can pool their grants to form larger corporate entities or manufacturing plants.
cons: Selection is highly phased and controlled locally by District Collectors; not everyone who applies gets it immediately.
application_steps: Eligible SC families are identified by local administration/MLAs during phased rollouts.
Beneficiary selects an enterprise and opens a dedicated bank account.
District Collector approves the business plan.
Funds are directly deposited into the beneficiary's account to purchase assets.

name: Nethanna Ku Cheyutha (Weaver's Thrift Fund Scheme)
ministry: Handlooms and Textiles Department, Govt of Telangana
effective_interest_rate_note: This is a thrift saving scheme. For every 8% of wages saved by the weaver, the State Government contributes a matching 16% to their thrift account.
eligibility_human: Handloom, powerloom weavers, and ancillary workers (dyers, warpers) in Telangana who are members of Handloom Weavers Cooperative Societies (HWCS) or working outside cooperatives.
pros: Provides an unprecedented 200% matching contribution (16% govt vs 8% weaver) to build long-term capital for artisans.
The accumulated fund can be withdrawn after 3 years for business expansion, health, or family needs.
cons: Requires consistent wage deposits; if the weaver stops contributing, the government matching stops.
application_steps: Weaver opens a Thrift Fund account in the designated bank (usually Testco or local cooperative).
Weaver deposits 8% of their declared monthly wages.
State government automatically transfers 16% matching grant into the locked account monthly.

name: YSR Jagananna Chedodu
ministry: Backward Classes Welfare Department
effective_interest_rate_note: A direct cash transfer of ₹10,000 per annum. No loan involved.
eligibility_human: Tailors (Darzi), Barbers (Nayee Brahmins), and Washermen (Rajakas) in Andhra Pradesh who own a registered shop. Rural family income must be under ₹1.20 Lakh, urban under ₹1.44 Lakh.
pros: Direct ₹10,000 annual cash support helps micro-entrepreneurs purchase tools (scissors, irons, sewing machines).
Process is entirely decentralized at the village secretariat level.
cons: Strict requirement of owning a physical shop; itinerant/mobile workers do not qualify.
application_steps: Apply via the village/ward volunteer at the local Sachivalayam.
Volunteer conducts physical verification of the shop.
Eligible lists are displayed for social audit.
Amount is disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

name: YSR Vahana Mitra
ministry: Transport Department, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
effective_interest_rate_note: A direct cash transfer of ₹10,000 per annum for vehicle maintenance and insurance. No loan involved.
eligibility_human: Self-employed auto, taxi, or maxi cab drivers in Andhra Pradesh who own the commercial vehicle they drive. Must possess a valid driving license and fall below the BPL income threshold.

documents_required.name: Vehicle Registration Card (RC) in applicant's name

pros: Helps drivers offset the recurring costs of insurance, fitness certificates, and vehicle repairs.
Unconditional DBT transfer directly into the bank account annually.
cons: Only owner-drivers are eligible; drivers renting autos are excluded.
application_steps: Submit application with RC and Driving License to Village/Ward Volunteer.
Transport department verifies vehicle ownership.
Funds transferred via DBT annually.

name: YSR Nethanna Nestham
ministry: Handlooms and Textiles Department, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
effective_interest_rate_note: A direct cash transfer of ₹24,000 per annum. No loan involved.
eligibility_human: Handloom weaver families in Andhra Pradesh who physically own a handloom. The grant is designed to help them modernize their looms and buy yarn.
pros: Massive ₹24,000 annual cash injection helps weavers avoid high-interest moneylenders for raw material procurement.
cons: Ancillary workers (dyers, spinners) who do not own the actual loom structure are ineligible.
application_steps: Apply via Grama Sachivalayam volunteer.
Physical verification of the handloom structure by department officials.
DBT release directly to the weaver's bank account.

name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (MMYSY Chhattisgarh)
ministry: Department of Commerce and Industries, Govt of Chhattisgarh
effective_interest_rate_note: Standard bank loan interest rates apply. The government provides 25% margin money subsidy (15% for General category) on project costs.
eligibility_human: Youth of Chhattisgarh aged 18 to 35 years (relaxed by 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Women) who have passed at least 8th standard, setting up a new business. Family income must not exceed ₹3 Lakh per annum.
pros: Good loan ceiling: up to ₹25 Lakh for industry, ₹10 Lakh for service, and ₹2 Lakh for retail business.
Low educational requirement (8th standard).
cons: Requires physical application submission at DTIC.
Subsidy is capped at ₹1.5 Lakh for General category (15%) and ₹3.75 Lakh for special categories (25%).
application_steps: Submit application and DPR to DTIC.
Task Force Committee interviews the candidate.
Application forwarded to the bank for loan sanction.
Bank disburses loan and DTIC releases margin money into a TDR account.

name: Mukhyamantri Swarojgar Yojana (MSY Uttarakhand)
ministry: MSME Department, Govt of Uttarakhand

hill_districts.note: Subsidy percentage varies by location: Category A (Hill districts) gets 25% (max ₹6.25L), Category B gets 20% (max ₹5L), Categories C & D (Plains) get 15% (max ₹3.75L). Special category applicants (SC/ST/Women) get additional 5% top-up in plain areas.

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard bank term loan rates apply. Substantial margin money subsidy reduces borrower liability.
eligibility_human: Residents of Uttarakhand aged 18+ looking to establish a new manufacturing unit (up to ₹25 Lakh) or service/business unit (up to ₹10 Lakh). No minimum education qualification is required.
pros: Incentivizes reverse migration to hill districts by offering higher subsidy rates (25%).
No educational bar whatsoever, unlike many other state margin money schemes.
cons: If the business closes within 3 years, the margin money subsidy must be refunded.
application_steps: Register and apply on the MSY Uttarakhand portal.
DIC evaluates and forwards the file to the selected bank branch.
Bank disburses the loan and the state credits margin money to the bank as a TDR.

name: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana (MSSY)
ministry: Renewable Energy Department, Govt of Uttarakhand

hill_districts.note: Aligned with MSME rules: up to 25% subsidy for Hill districts and 15% for Plain districts.

effective_interest_rate_note: Loans are provided by cooperative banks at a flat 8% interest rate for 15 years. Power produced is bought by UPCL.
eligibility_human: Residents of Uttarakhand, specially returned migrants, looking to set up 20 kW to 25 kW grid-tied solar power plants on their own or leased land.
pros: Guaranteed 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with the state grid (UPCL) provides a secure, steady income stream.
Financed generously by cooperative banks for up to 15 years at a fixed 8% rate.
cons: Applicant must own or lease suitable land close to a UPCL power sub-station for grid connectivity.
application_steps: Register on the MSY portal and select Solar Swarojgar Yojana.
Submit land details; UREDA and UPCL conduct a technical feasibility survey.
Bank sanctions the loan. UPCL signs a 25-year PPA with the applicant.
Install the 25 kW plant and start selling electricity to the grid.

name: Mumkin Scheme (Mission Youth)
ministry: Mission Youth, Govt of Jammu & Kashmir

manufacturer_discount.note: 10% subsidy (up to ₹80,000) is provided by the J&K Government, AND another 10% (up to ₹80,000) is provided upfront as a special discount by the vehicle manufacturer (e.g., Tata, Mahindra).

effective_interest_rate_note: 100% on-road financing by J&K Bank. The 20% total margin money eliminates the need for the youth to pay any down payment.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Jammu & Kashmir aged 18 to 35 who hold a valid driving license for commercial vehicles.
pros: Zero down payment required to buy a small commercial vehicle (like Tata Ace or Mahindra Bolero Pickup).
Combined 20% subsidy between the government and the vehicle manufacturer.
cons: Requires a commercial driving license prior to application.
application_steps: Register on the Mission Youth J&K portal.
Select the desired vehicle from partner manufacturers.
Application is forwarded to J&K Bank for 100% on-road financing.
Government and manufacturer release their respective 10% margins to the bank.

name: Tejaswini Scheme (Mission Youth)
ministry: Mission Youth, Govt of Jammu & Kashmir

interest_subvention.note: Mission Youth pays 100% of the interest amount to the bank, rendering the ₹5 Lakh loan entirely interest-free for the borrower.

effective_interest_rate_note: 0% interest loan. Government of J&K completely sponsors the interest component and provides an upfront ₹50,000 margin money subsidy.
eligibility_human: Young women of Jammu & Kashmir aged 18 to 35 who have passed at least 10th standard, seeking to establish a new self-employment venture.
pros: Exceptional financial product: entirely interest-free loan up to ₹5 Lakh.
10% upfront capital subsidy (₹50,000) reduces the principal.
Tailored specifically to boost female labor force participation in J&K.
cons: Strict timely repayment is required to maintain the 100% interest sponsorship.
application_steps: Submit application and business plan on the Mission Youth portal.
District Level Committee interviews the candidate.
Application is sponsored to J&K Bank.
Mission Youth transfers the margin money to the bank and pays the interest EMIs directly.

name: Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)
ministry: Department of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Govt of Goa

women_and_reserved.note: Women, ST, SC, and OBC get 50% share capital subsidy (max ₹2.5 Lakh). General category men receive up to 50% subsidy capped at ₹2 Lakh. Interest rate is reduced to 2% for women/SC/ST and 6% for general category.

effective_interest_rate_note: Nominal interest of 2% for Women/SC/ST/OBC and 6% for General Category after subvention. An additional 2% rebate is provided for timely repayment.
eligibility_human: Residents of Goa (minimum 15 years domicile) aged 18 to 45 who have passed at least the 8th standard, setting up new micro-enterprises.
pros: Extremely low effective interest rate (as low as 0% for women after prompt repayment rebate).
EDC conducts all appraisals directly, bypassing traditional commercial bank bottlenecks.
cons: Strict 15-year Goan domicile requirement excludes recent migrants.
Requires one or two local guarantors depending on the loan amount.
application_steps: Download the application from the EDC portal or visit EDC House in Panaji.
Submit the application with business plan and guarantor details.
EDC evaluates and sanctions the loan directly.
Applicant undergoes brief mandatory training before loan disbursement.

name: Skilled Youth Startup Scheme (SYSS)
ministry: Commerce & Industries Department, Govt of Sikkim

women_and_bpl.note: Women entrepreneurs, BPL candidates, and physically challenged applicants receive an enhanced 65% subsidy (up to ₹13 Lakh).

effective_interest_rate_note: A massive 50% to 65% upfront capital subsidy heavily reduces the principal loan amount.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Sikkim possessing a Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification, aged 18 to 40, establishing manufacturing, agriculture, or service units.
pros: One of the highest subsidy percentages in India (up to 65%).
Explicitly covers homestays, eco-tourism, and organic farming which are crucial to Sikkim's economy.
cons: Requires applicant to contribute at least 10% (General) or 5% (Special Category) from their own pocket.
Strictly limited to COI holders (indigenous residents).
application_steps: Submit application and DPR to the District Industries Centre.
District Level Screening Committee evaluates the proposal.
Application is forwarded to SISCO Bank or SBI.
Subsidy is released directly to the bank as margin money.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana (DDUSY)
ministry: Department of Planning and Investment, Govt of Arunachal Pradesh
implementing_agency: State Bank of India / AP Rural Bank

women_entrepreneurs.note: Women entrepreneurs receive an additional 5% interest subvention annually on top of the 30% capital subsidy.

effective_interest_rate_note: Provides a 30% front-ended capital subsidy to offset the loan principal, plus a 5% interest subvention for women entrepreneurs.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth and entrepreneurs holding Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) certificates, initiating projects from ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore in eco-tourism, agri-allied, or traditional crafts.

documents_required.name: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Lease Agreement

pros: Massive ₹30 Lakh maximum subsidy limit enables high-value infrastructure like eco-lodges and commercial piggeries.
Front-ended subsidy mechanism ensures immediate reduction of the bank loan burden.
cons: Borrower must deposit their 10% to 30% margin contribution upfront before the government subsidy is triggered.
application_steps: Submit DPR to the Deputy Commissioner's office.
DLSC interviews the applicant and recommends the project.
State Level Screening Committee approves the recommendation.
Bank sanctions the loan; state government releases the 30% upfront subsidy directly to the bank.

name: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI)
ministry: Agriculture & Allied Departments, Govt of Nagaland

kcc_interest_subvention.note: A 4% interest subvention is provided on working capital loans via KCC under this scheme.

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard lending rates apply with the state providing a 30% flat capital subsidy and a 4% interest subvention for working capital.
eligibility_human: Farmers, entrepreneurs, FPOs, and SHGs in Nagaland seeking to boost agri-allied productivity (e.g., piggery, poultry, food processing, commercial vehicles).
pros: Substantial 30% subsidy to scale up local agriculture and meat production.
Applicant contribution is only 10%; the bank finances the remaining 60%.
cons: NOCs from the village council are strictly mandated for physical projects.
application_steps: Submit application on the CMMFI portal.
District Level Implementation Committee (DLIC) headed by the DC screens the proposal.
Recommended applications are sent to banks.
State subsidy is released directly to the loan account post-sanction.

name: PRIME Livelihood Enterprise Advancement (Meghalaya)
ministry: Planning Department, Govt of Meghalaya

interest_subvention.note: Entrepreneurs accessing formal bank credit under PRIME also get a 5% interest subvention.

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure scale-up grant (Kickstart Grant up to ₹5 Lakh) combined with 0% interest start-up loans via the PRIME Fund.
eligibility_human: Entrepreneurs and startups resident in Meghalaya enrolled in the PRIME incubation program.
pros: Direct scale-up grants up to ₹5 Lakh requiring no repayment.
Comprehensive incubation support (workspace, legal, mentoring) at PRIME hubs across the state.
cons: Grants are highly competitive and awarded through a pitch competition format (PRIME Entrepreneurship Pitch).
application_steps: Apply during an active PRIME Cohort call.
Participate in the incubation program and refine the business model.
Pitch before a jury to secure the Kickstart Scale-up Grant or 0% interest loan.

name: Swavalamban Scheme (Tripura)
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt of Tripura
effective_interest_rate_note: Standard commercial bank lending rates apply with an upfront margin money subsidy from the state.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Tripura aged 18-50 who are 8th standard pass and establishing small manufacturing or service units.
pros: Provides 30% margin money upfront to reduce bank loan dependency.
cons: Low overall subsidy ceiling (max ₹1 Lakh).
application_steps: Submit physical application at local DIC.
Task Force Committee evaluates the proposal.
Bank disburses loan; DIC releases subsidy to the bank account.

name: NEDP Micro Enterprise Scheme
ministry: Planning & Programme Implementation Department, Govt of Mizoram
effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% direct seed grant for establishing micro-enterprises under the New Economic Development Policy (NEDP).
eligibility_human: Residents of Mizoram setting up new startups or micro-enterprises in thrust sectors (bamboo, food processing, handloom, IT).
pros: Non-repayable seed grant directly boosts entrepreneurship without adding debt burdens.
cons: Subject to irregular state budget allocations under the NEDP umbrella.
application_steps: Submit business plan in response to department call for proposals.
Present business idea to the screening committee.
Funds are released in tranches corresponding to physical progress of the business.

name: UP Startup Policy (Seed Fund)
ministry: IT and Electronics Department, Govt of UP

women_and_marginalized.note: Startups with women, SC, ST, or Divyang founders get an additional 50% top-up on the marketing and sustenance allowance (up to ₹7.5 Lakh total seed capital).

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure grant disbursed as a sustenance allowance (₹17,500/month) and a marketing/seed grant (up to ₹7.5 Lakh).
eligibility_human: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated in Uttar Pradesh that are actively incubated at a state-recognized incubator.
pros: Provides a ₹17,500 monthly sustenance allowance for 1 year.
Seed capital up to ₹7.5 Lakh helps launch the MVP to market without giving up equity.
cons: Mandatory requirement to be physically/virtually incubated at a UP-recognized incubator.
application_steps: Register startup on the StartinUP portal.
Incubator vets the startup and submits a recommendation letter.
State PIU evaluates and sanctions the sustenance/seed grant via nodal agency.

name: Bihar Startup Policy Seed Fund
ministry: Department of Industries, Govt of Bihar

women_sc_st.note: Women, SC, ST, and Divyang founders receive a 5% to 15% top-up on the standard ₹10 Lakh fund (i.e., up to ₹11.5 Lakh).

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% interest-free seed loan up to ₹10 Lakhs, repayable only after a massive 10-year moratorium period.
eligibility_human: Startups registered in Bihar functioning for less than 10 years with an innovative product or scalable business model. Must be certified by the Bihar Startup Trust.
pros: Effectively functions as a grant for a decade due to the unparalleled 10-year interest-free moratorium.
Additional ₹3 Lakh grant for product validation/testing.
cons: Funds are disbursed based on rigorous multi-stage evaluations; it is a highly competitive state fund.
application_steps: Apply during an active cohort on the Bihar Startup portal.
Undergo preliminary screening and pitching session before the BSFT committee.
Sign the MoU; seed fund is released to the startup's current account.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Udyami Yojana (MMKUY)
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP

interest_subvention.note: A 5% interest subvention for 7 years on term loans (capped at ₹5 Lakh per year), plus guarantee fee waiver.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 5% interest reduction on commercial bank rates for 7 years, combined with an upfront 15% margin money subsidy.
eligibility_human: Sons and daughters of farmers in Madhya Pradesh aged 18-45 who are 10th pass, setting up agro-processing, food manufacturing, or custom hiring centers.

documents_required.name: Proof of Parent being a Farmer (Khasra/Khatauni)

pros: Enables huge projects (up to ₹2 Crore) specifically targeting farmer families moving into agro-processing.
Combines 15% margin money, 5% interest subvention, and CGTMSE guarantee fee payment.
cons: Applicant's parents must officially own agricultural land in MP to qualify as a 'farmer's child'.
application_steps: Apply online on the MP Samast portal.
DTIC scrutinizes the farming credentials and project viability.
Forwarded to bank for collateral-free sanction under CGTMSE.
State deposits margin money as TDR and handles interest subvention annually.

name: Udyogini Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation (KSWDC)

sc_st_women.note: SC and ST women entrepreneurs receive a massive 50% subsidy on the loan amount (General category gets 30%).

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard bank loan interest rates apply. The government provides 30%-50% capital subsidy which heavily offsets the principal.
eligibility_human: Women of Karnataka aged 18 to 55 setting up micro-enterprises in 88 approved categories (bakeries, tailoring, retail). Family income must be under ₹1.5 Lakh per annum (no income limit for SC/ST).
pros: Provides up to 50% capital subsidy for SC/ST women on loans up to ₹30 Lakh.
Covers basic commercial and retail trades commonly undertaken by rural/semi-urban women.
cons: Strict ₹1.5 Lakh income ceiling for general category women.
application_steps: Obtain application from Deputy Director, Women and Child Development (WCD) office.
Submit physical application with project details.
KSWDC evaluates and routes the file to the local bank.
Bank disburses loan; KSWDC releases subsidy.

name: Seed Money Scheme (SMS) Maharashtra
ministry: Directorate of Industries, Maharashtra

reserved_categories.note: SC, ST, OBC, NT, VT, and Divyang applicants receive 20% seed money assistance.

effective_interest_rate_note: A highly subsidized soft loan covering 15% to 20% of the project cost at 6% per annum. Bank finances 75%.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Maharashtra aged 18 to 50 (relaxed for special categories) with a minimum 7th standard pass, undertaking manufacturing or service projects up to ₹25 Lakh.
pros: Addresses the 'margin money' gap by lending 15-20% of the project cost at a flat 6% interest.
The state seed loan has an incredible 3-year moratorium (payment holiday).
cons: It is a soft loan, not a free grant/subsidy, meaning it must eventually be repaid.
Requires commercial bank to sanction the primary 75% loan first.
application_steps: Apply online on the Directorate of Industries Maharashtra portal.
DIC issues provisional approval.
Approach bank to secure 75% term loan sanction.
DIC releases the 15% seed loan to bridge the applicant's equity requirement.

name: Dattopant Thengadi Artisan Interest Subsidy Yojana (DTAISY)
ministry: Cottage and Rural Industries Department, Govt of Gujarat
implementing_agency: DIC / Gujarat State Handloom & Handicraft Development Corporation
effective_interest_rate_note: A fixed 7% interest subvention per annum on machinery/raw material loans. Borrower pays a nominal remaining margin.
eligibility_human: Traditional artisans and handloom weavers in Gujarat aged 18+ holding an Artisan Identity Card. No specific income limit applies.
pros: Provides extremely cheap working capital and tool financing (up to ₹1 Lakh) for traditional weavers and potters.
Fully digital application process through e-Kutir.
cons: Low loan ceiling limit (₹1,00,000) restricts heavy mechanization.
application_steps: Register as an artisan on the e-Kutir portal.
Apply for the DTAISY loan.
DIC evaluates and forwards to the bank.
Bank disburses the loan; state credits the 7% interest difference quarterly.

pros: Massive 40% central subsidy for a niche, eco-friendly manufacturing sector.

cons: Strictly limited to coir and coconut-husk processing projects.

Project is appraised by the Coir Board and forwarded to a bank.
Bank sanctions the composite loan (term + working capital).
Coir Board releases the 40% subsidy into a term deposit account for final adjustment.

effective_interest_rate_note: Highly concessional interest rates scaled by loan size: up to ₹5 Lakh (6%), ₹5L-₹15L (7%), ₹15L-₹30L (8%).
eligibility_human: Scheduled Caste (SC) individuals whose annual family income is up to ₹3 Lakh. Can be used for any viable income-generating business.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
implementing_agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
effective_interest_rate_note: A fixed nominal 4% interest rate per annum is charged. NSKFDC finances 90%, while the State Channelizing Agency finances 10%.
eligibility_human: Women from Safai Karamchari, Manual Scavenger, or Waste Picker communities (and their dependent daughters) starting small income-generating businesses.
pros: Provides ultra-low interest (4%) micro-credit to highly marginalized women without any collateral requirements.
cons: Strict occupational eligibility limits the applicant pool exclusively to sanitation/waste workers and their dependents.
application_steps: Apply through the local State SC/ST Finance Corporation or designated RRB.
Submit proof of occupation.
Loan is disbursed directly to help purchase sewing machines, carts, or retail inventory.

name: Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY)
ministry: Department of Industries, Trade and Commerce, Govt of Goa

women_and_reserved.note: Women, ST, SC, and OBC get 50% share capital subsidy (max ₹2.5 Lakh). General category men receive up to 50% subsidy capped at ₹2 Lakh. Interest rate is reduced to 2% for women/SC/ST and 6% for general category.

effective_interest_rate_note: Nominal interest of 2% for Women/SC/ST/OBC and 6% for General Category after subvention. An additional 2% rebate is provided for timely repayment.
eligibility_human: Residents of Goa (minimum 15 years domicile) aged 18 to 45 who have passed at least the 8th standard, setting up new micro-enterprises.
pros: Extremely low effective interest rate (as low as 0% for women after prompt repayment rebate).
EDC conducts all appraisals directly, bypassing traditional commercial bank bottlenecks.
cons: Strict 15-year Goan domicile requirement excludes recent migrants.
Requires one or two local guarantors depending on the loan amount.
application_steps: Download the application from the EDC portal or visit EDC House in Panaji.
Submit the application with business plan and guarantor details.
EDC evaluates and sanctions the loan directly.
Applicant undergoes brief mandatory training before loan disbursement.

name: Skilled Youth Startup Scheme (SYSS)
ministry: Commerce & Industries Department, Govt of Sikkim

women_and_bpl.note: Women entrepreneurs, BPL candidates, and physically challenged applicants receive an enhanced 65% subsidy (up to ₹13 Lakh).

effective_interest_rate_note: A massive 50% to 65% upfront capital subsidy heavily reduces the principal loan amount.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Sikkim possessing a Sikkim Subject Certificate or Certificate of Identification, aged 18 to 40, establishing manufacturing, agriculture, or service units.
pros: One of the highest subsidy percentages in India (up to 65%).
Explicitly covers homestays, eco-tourism, and organic farming which are crucial to Sikkim's economy.
cons: Requires applicant to contribute at least 10% (General) or 5% (Special Category) from their own pocket.
Strictly limited to COI holders (indigenous residents).
application_steps: Submit application and DPR to the District Industries Centre.
District Level Screening Committee evaluates the proposal.
Application is forwarded to SISCO Bank or SBI.
Subsidy is released directly to the bank as margin money.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana (DDUSY)
ministry: Department of Planning and Investment, Govt of Arunachal Pradesh
implementing_agency: State Bank of India / AP Rural Bank

women_entrepreneurs.note: Women entrepreneurs receive an additional 5% interest subvention annually on top of the 30% capital subsidy.

effective_interest_rate_note: Provides a 30% front-ended capital subsidy to offset the loan principal, plus a 5% interest subvention for women entrepreneurs.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth and entrepreneurs holding Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe (APST) certificates, initiating projects from ₹10 Lakh to ₹1 Crore in eco-tourism, agri-allied, or traditional crafts.

documents_required.name: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Lease Agreement

pros: Massive ₹30 Lakh maximum subsidy limit enables high-value infrastructure like eco-lodges and commercial piggeries.
Front-ended subsidy mechanism ensures immediate reduction of the bank loan burden.
cons: Borrower must deposit their 10% to 30% margin contribution upfront before the government subsidy is triggered.
application_steps: Submit DPR to the Deputy Commissioner's office.
DLSC interviews the applicant and recommends the project.
State Level Screening Committee approves the recommendation.
Bank sanctions the loan; state government releases the 30% upfront subsidy directly to the bank.

name: Chief Minister's Micro Finance Initiative (CMMFI)
ministry: Agriculture & Allied Departments, Govt of Nagaland

kcc_interest_subvention.note: A 4% interest subvention is provided on working capital loans via KCC under this scheme.

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard lending rates apply with the state providing a 30% flat capital subsidy and a 4% interest subvention for working capital.
eligibility_human: Farmers, entrepreneurs, FPOs, and SHGs in Nagaland seeking to boost agri-allied productivity (e.g., piggery, poultry, food processing, commercial vehicles).
pros: Substantial 30% subsidy to scale up local agriculture and meat production.
Applicant contribution is only 10%; the bank finances the remaining 60%.
cons: NOCs from the village council are strictly mandated for physical projects.
application_steps: Submit application on the CMMFI portal.
District Level Implementation Committee (DLIC) headed by the DC screens the proposal.
Recommended applications are sent to banks.
State subsidy is released directly to the loan account post-sanction.

name: PRIME Livelihood Enterprise Advancement (Meghalaya)
ministry: Planning Department, Govt of Meghalaya

interest_subvention.note: Entrepreneurs accessing formal bank credit under PRIME also get a 5% interest subvention.

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure scale-up grant (Kickstart Grant up to ₹5 Lakh) combined with 0% interest start-up loans via the PRIME Fund.
eligibility_human: Entrepreneurs and startups resident in Meghalaya enrolled in the PRIME incubation program.
pros: Direct scale-up grants up to ₹5 Lakh requiring no repayment.
Comprehensive incubation support (workspace, legal, mentoring) at PRIME hubs across the state.
cons: Grants are highly competitive and awarded through a pitch competition format (PRIME Entrepreneurship Pitch).
application_steps: Apply during an active PRIME Cohort call.
Participate in the incubation program and refine the business model.
Pitch before a jury to secure the Kickstart Scale-up Grant or 0% interest loan.

name: Swavalamban Scheme (Tripura)
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Govt of Tripura
effective_interest_rate_note: Standard commercial bank lending rates apply with an upfront margin money subsidy from the state.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Tripura aged 18-50 who are 8th standard pass and establishing small manufacturing or service units.
pros: Provides 30% margin money upfront to reduce bank loan dependency.
cons: Low overall subsidy ceiling (max ₹1 Lakh).
application_steps: Submit physical application at local DIC.
Task Force Committee evaluates the proposal.
Bank disburses loan; DIC releases subsidy to the bank account.

name: NEDP Micro Enterprise Scheme
ministry: Planning & Programme Implementation Department, Govt of Mizoram
effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% direct seed grant for establishing micro-enterprises under the New Economic Development Policy (NEDP).
eligibility_human: Residents of Mizoram setting up new startups or micro-enterprises in thrust sectors (bamboo, food processing, handloom, IT).
pros: Non-repayable seed grant directly boosts entrepreneurship without adding debt burdens.
cons: Subject to irregular state budget allocations under the NEDP umbrella.
application_steps: Submit business plan in response to department call for proposals.
Present business idea to the screening committee.
Funds are released in tranches corresponding to physical progress of the business.

name: UP Startup Policy (Seed Fund)
ministry: IT and Electronics Department, Govt of UP

women_and_marginalized.note: Startups with women, SC, ST, or Divyang founders get an additional 50% top-up on the marketing and sustenance allowance (up to ₹7.5 Lakh total seed capital).

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure grant disbursed as a sustenance allowance (₹17,500/month) and a marketing/seed grant (up to ₹7.5 Lakh).
eligibility_human: DPIIT-recognized startups incorporated in Uttar Pradesh that are actively incubated at a state-recognized incubator.
pros: Provides a ₹17,500 monthly sustenance allowance for 1 year.
Seed capital up to ₹7.5 Lakh helps launch the MVP to market without giving up equity.
cons: Mandatory requirement to be physically/virtually incubated at a UP-recognized incubator.
application_steps: Register startup on the StartinUP portal.
Incubator vets the startup and submits a recommendation letter.
State PIU evaluates and sanctions the sustenance/seed grant via nodal agency.

name: Bihar Startup Policy Seed Fund
ministry: Department of Industries, Govt of Bihar

women_sc_st.note: Women, SC, ST, and Divyang founders receive a 5% to 15% top-up on the standard ₹10 Lakh fund (i.e., up to ₹11.5 Lakh).

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% interest-free seed loan up to ₹10 Lakhs, repayable only after a massive 10-year moratorium period.
eligibility_human: Startups registered in Bihar functioning for less than 10 years with an innovative product or scalable business model. Must be certified by the Bihar Startup Trust.
pros: Effectively functions as a grant for a decade due to the unparalleled 10-year interest-free moratorium.
Additional ₹3 Lakh grant for product validation/testing.
cons: Funds are disbursed based on rigorous multi-stage evaluations; it is a highly competitive state fund.
application_steps: Apply during an active cohort on the Bihar Startup portal.
Undergo preliminary screening and pitching session before the BSFT committee.
Sign the MoU; seed fund is released to the startup's current account.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Udyami Yojana (MMKUY)
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department, MP

interest_subvention.note: A 5% interest subvention for 7 years on term loans (capped at ₹5 Lakh per year), plus guarantee fee waiver.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 5% interest reduction on commercial bank rates for 7 years, combined with an upfront 15% margin money subsidy.
eligibility_human: Sons and daughters of farmers in Madhya Pradesh aged 18-45 who are 10th pass, setting up agro-processing, food manufacturing, or custom hiring centers.

documents_required.name: Proof of Parent being a Farmer (Khasra/Khatauni)

pros: Enables huge projects (up to ₹2 Crore) specifically targeting farmer families moving into agro-processing.
Combines 15% margin money, 5% interest subvention, and CGTMSE guarantee fee payment.
cons: Applicant's parents must officially own agricultural land in MP to qualify as a 'farmer's child'.
application_steps: Apply online on the MP Samast portal.
DTIC scrutinizes the farming credentials and project viability.
Forwarded to bank for collateral-free sanction under CGTMSE.
State deposits margin money as TDR and handles interest subvention annually.

name: Udyogini Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation (KSWDC)

sc_st_women.note: SC and ST women entrepreneurs receive a massive 50% subsidy on the loan amount (General category gets 30%).

effective_interest_rate_note: Standard bank loan interest rates apply. The government provides 30%-50% capital subsidy which heavily offsets the principal.
eligibility_human: Women of Karnataka aged 18 to 55 setting up micro-enterprises in 88 approved categories (bakeries, tailoring, retail). Family income must be under ₹1.5 Lakh per annum (no income limit for SC/ST).
pros: Provides up to 50% capital subsidy for SC/ST women on loans up to ₹30 Lakh.
Covers basic commercial and retail trades commonly undertaken by rural/semi-urban women.
cons: Strict ₹1.5 Lakh income ceiling for general category women.
application_steps: Obtain application from Deputy Director, Women and Child Development (WCD) office.
Submit physical application with project details.
KSWDC evaluates and routes the file to the local bank.
Bank disburses loan; KSWDC releases subsidy.

name: Seed Money Scheme (SMS) Maharashtra
ministry: Directorate of Industries, Maharashtra

reserved_categories.note: SC, ST, OBC, NT, VT, and Divyang applicants receive 20% seed money assistance.

effective_interest_rate_note: A highly subsidized soft loan covering 15% to 20% of the project cost at 6% per annum. Bank finances 75%.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth of Maharashtra aged 18 to 50 (relaxed for special categories) with a minimum 7th standard pass, undertaking manufacturing or service projects up to ₹25 Lakh.
pros: Addresses the 'margin money' gap by lending 15-20% of the project cost at a flat 6% interest.
The state seed loan has an incredible 3-year moratorium (payment holiday).
cons: It is a soft loan, not a free grant/subsidy, meaning it must eventually be repaid.
Requires commercial bank to sanction the primary 75% loan first.
application_steps: Apply online on the Directorate of Industries Maharashtra portal.
DIC issues provisional approval.
Approach bank to secure 75% term loan sanction.
DIC releases the 15% seed loan to bridge the applicant's equity requirement.

name: Krishi Yantra Dhare (Farm Machinery Custom Hiring Centres)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka

sc_st_women_fpo.note: SC, ST, and Women farmers receive an additional 50% discount on the already subsidized rental rates for farm machinery.

effective_interest_rate_note: Not a loan scheme. Provides 50% reduced rental rates (₹200-₹2,000/acre) compared to the private market for expensive farm machinery.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Karnataka seeking to rent modern farm equipment (tractors, harvesters, rotavators, drone sprayers). Must hold a valid Fruits ID.
pros: Democratizes access to high-end farm mechanization for small/marginal farmers without requiring capital expenditure.
Can be booked conveniently via the 'Yantra Karnataka' mobile app.
Certified operator is provided with the machine.
cons: Availability of specific machinery depends entirely on peak season demand at the local CHC.
application_steps: Register on the Yantra Karnataka mobile app using Fruits ID.
Browse available machinery at the nearest Custom Hiring Centre (CHC).
Select booking date, acreage, and pay the subsidized rental fee online.
Operator arrives with the machine and executes the farm work.

name: Krishi Bhagya Yojana (Karnataka)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Karnataka

sc_st_farmers.note: Subsidy jumps from 80% to 90% (up to ₹80,000 for farm ponds) for SC and ST farmers. Polyhouses receive up to 50% subsidy capped at ₹15 Lakh/acre.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct capital grant reducing the cost of constructing farm ponds (Krishi Honda) and polyhouses.
eligibility_human: Small and marginal farmers in dryland/rainfed districts of Karnataka owning at least 1 acre of land, looking to build rainwater harvesting ponds or install polyhouses.
pros: Massive 80-90% subsidy for digging farm ponds, significantly drought-proofing rainfed agricultural lands.
Includes subsidies for diesel pump sets and polythene lining to prevent water seepage.
cons: Strictly limited to designated dryland/drought-prone taluks; irrigated regions are excluded.
Subsidy is back-ended and paid only after the pond is physically verified.
application_steps: Register on the Karnataka Fruits Portal to obtain an ID.
Submit application with land records at the nearest RSK.
Agriculture officer surveys the land and grants approval.
Farmer excavates the pond. Subsidy is released via DBT post-completion verification.

name: YSR Sunna Vaddi Panta Runalu
ministry: Agriculture Department, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
effective_interest_rate_note: 0% effective interest rate. The state government reimburses the entire interest amount directly into the farmer's bank account for crop loans up to ₹1 Lakh, provided the loan is repaid within 1 year.
eligibility_human: Below Poverty Line (BPL) farmers and tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh who avail of short-term crop loans via KCC and repay them promptly within the stipulated 12-month period.
pros: Completely eradicates the interest burden on working capital for small farmers.
Automated backend claim process tied directly to the e-Crop portal.
cons: If the farmer delays repayment past the 1-year mark, the entire interest subsidy is revoked.
The farmer's crop MUST be registered on the e-Crop portal during the sowing season to qualify.
application_steps: Avail a short-term crop loan from a bank and register the sown crop on the e-Crop portal via RBK.
Repay the principal amount to the bank within the 1-year timeline.
The State Government automatically deposits the full interest amount to the farmer's account during the annual disbursement cycle.

name: Magel Tyala Shet Tale (Farm Pond on Demand)
ministry: Agriculture Department, Govt of Maharashtra
effective_interest_rate_note: A pure direct benefit transfer (DBT) grant. No bank loan is required.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Maharashtra owning at least 0.60 hectares (approx 1.5 acres) of land. High priority is given to farmers in suicide-prone districts, BPL families, and widows.
pros: Provides up to ₹75,000 for constructing a farm pond on demand, effectively securing crop lifecycles during dry spells.
The scheme has a decentralized, paperless application via the MahaDBT farmer portal.
cons: Plastic lining costs (to prevent seepage) are often higher than the subsidy, requiring out-of-pocket expenses.
application_steps: Register on the MahaDBT Farmer Portal and select 'Irrigation Facilities'.
Apply for Farm Pond; application goes into a lottery/queue system.
Upon selection, receive technical approval. Construct the pond according to prescribed dimensions (e.g., 30x30x3m).
Agriculture officer geo-tags the pond; ₹50,000 to ₹75,000 is credited directly to the bank account.

name: PM Krishak Mitra Surya Yojana (Mukhyamantri Solar Pump Yojana)
ministry: New and Renewable Energy Department, Govt of MP
effective_interest_rate_note: A 90% capital subsidy on the total cost of the solar pump. The farmer pays only the remaining 10%.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh currently using expensive diesel pumps, possessing temporary agricultural power connections (3 HP / 5 HP), or lacking access to the electricity grid entirely.
pros: Provides day-time, free energy for irrigation, entirely eliminating diesel/grid costs.
An incredible 90% subsidy covers pumps up to 7.5 HP.
cons: Initial registration requires a non-refundable ₹5,000 fee.
If the farmer already has a permanent grid electricity connection for irrigation, they are lower priority or ineligible.
application_steps: Login to cmsolarpump.mp.gov.in via Aadhaar e-KYC and Samagra ID.
Select the desired pump capacity (e.g., 5 HP DC Submersible) and verify land records.
Pay the initial ₹5,000 registration fee online.
Upon allotment, pay the remaining 10% beneficiary share. MPUVNL handles installation via empanelled vendors.

name: Subhiksha Keralam
ministry: Agriculture Development and Farmers' Welfare Department, Govt of Kerala
implementing_agency: Local Self Government Institutions (LSGIs) / Krishi Bhavans

fallow_land.note: Provides ₹40,000 per hectare for paddy cultivation on fallow lands, and specific per-hectare grants for tubers, bananas, and vegetables.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct agricultural input and production grant.
eligibility_human: Farmers, youth, returnee NRIs, SHGs (Kudumbashree), and Joint Liability Groups in Kerala who wish to undertake integrated farming, poultry, dairy, or cultivate on barren/fallow lands.
pros: Aggressively incentivizes the return to farming by offering cash grants to clear and cultivate abandoned land.
Comprehensive approach covering not just crops, but fisheries, poultry, and dairy integration.
cons: Grants are acreage-based, meaning ultra-small landholders receive very small absolute amounts.
application_steps: Register on the AIMS Kerala portal under the Subhiksha Keralam module.
Select the category (individual/group) and the crop/activity.
Local Krishi Officer verifies the fallow land status or proposed project.
Input subsidies (seeds, fertilizers) or direct cash grants are released via the local Panchayat.

name: Odisha Millet Mission (OMM) - Enterprise Support
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Govt of Odisha

wshg_support.note: Women SHGs are provided specific grants (up to ₹3 Lakh) to establish millet processing units (pulverizers, dehullers) and Millet Tiffin Centres.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% direct capital equipment and operational grant. No loan required.
eligibility_human: Women Self Help Groups (WSHGs) and FPOs in Odisha looking to set up micro-processing units for millets or open 'Millet Shakti' food cafes.
pros: Provides end-to-end support for a highly profitable, climate-resilient crop (Ragi/Millets).
Free machinery provision (pulverizers, destoners) to village groups shifts value addition profits directly to the community.
cons: Highly localized to specific tribal and millet-growing blocks in Odisha.
application_steps: WSHG submits a resolution to the local block agriculture officer or facilitating NGO.
The group undergoes training in millet recipes and machine operation.
Processing machinery is delivered directly, or funds are provided to construct a Millet Tiffin Centre.

name: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pump Sets Scheme
ministry: Agriculture Engineering Department (AED), Govt of Tamil Nadu
effective_interest_rate_note: A 70% direct capital subsidy reducing the out-of-pocket installation cost of AC solar pump sets.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Tamil Nadu who own agricultural land with an open well or borewell, seeking to install off-grid solar water pumps up to 10 HP. Priority is given to those who withdraw their application for a free state electricity connection.
pros: Provides a hefty 70% subsidy (often converging PM-KUSUM with state funds), eliminating reliance on erratic grid power for irrigation.
Significantly speeds up access to irrigation compared to waiting decades for a free agricultural electricity connection.
cons: Installation is strictly restricted to government-empanelled EPC contractors.
application_steps: Submit application to the Assistant Executive Engineer, AED at the block level.
AED conducts a site feasibility inspection.
Farmer deposits the remaining 30% beneficiary share to the AED account via DD.
AED executes the installation through an approved vendor.

name: Kalaignar All Village Integrated Agriculture Development Programme
ministry: Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu

sc_st_clusters.note: 100% subsidy for drilling borewells/tube wells in clusters formed by SC/ST and small/marginal farmers, including free installation of pump sets.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% grant for village-level agricultural infrastructure. No loan required.
eligibility_human: Farmers residing in Gram Panchayats selected under the KAVIADP scheme. Covers landless agricultural laborers, small/marginal farmers, and SC/ST farmer clusters.
pros: Holistic village transformation: provides free coconut saplings, power weeders at subsidy, and establishes common community borewells entirely at government cost.
cons: Limited to the specific Gram Panchayats selected by the state government each financial year.
application_steps: Check if your village is covered under KAVIADP this year.
Attend the village-level camp organized by the Agriculture Department.
Register name for specific benefits (saplings, farm kits, or cluster borewell).
Benefits are distributed directly by the village committee.

name: CMSGUY Tractor Distribution Scheme
ministry: Agriculture Department, Govt of Assam
implementing_agency: Mega Mission Society - Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana
effective_interest_rate_note: Provides a massive 70% direct capital subsidy. The group contributes 10% margin money, and the remaining 20% is financed via a bank loan.
eligibility_human: Groups of 8-10 actual adult farmers in Assam forming a Joint Liability Group (JLG). Only one group per revenue village is selected.
pros: Extremely high subsidy limit (₹5.5 Lakh) enables the purchase of powerful tractors with implements.
The group can rent the tractor to other farmers in the village, generating robust secondary income.
cons: Highly competitive: Only one tractor is sanctioned per village.
Requires mobilizing a trustworthy group of 8 to 10 farmers.
application_steps: Form a JLG of 8-10 farmers and open a joint bank account.
Submit the application and tractor choice to the District Agriculture Officer.
District Level Committee (DLC) selects one group per village based on merit/lottery.
Group deposits 10% margin, bank sanctions 20% loan, and Govt deposits 70% subsidy to the bank.

name: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
ministry: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare Department, Govt of Chhattisgarh

crop_diversification.note: Farmers replacing paddy with pulses, oilseeds, or planting trees receive an enhanced input assistance of ₹10,000 per acre.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct cash transfer (input assistance) per acre of cultivated land. No loan involved.
eligibility_human: All landholding farmers in Chhattisgarh who cultivate paddy, maize, sugarcane, pulses, or oilseeds and have registered on the state procurement portal.
pros: Provides ₹9,000 to ₹10,000 per acre as a direct cash grant, massively improving farm liquidity before harvest.
Strongly incentivizes crop diversification away from water-intensive paddy.
cons: Assistance is released in four quarterly installments rather than a lump sum.
application_steps: Register crop details with the local Rural Agriculture Extension Officer (RAEO) or Primary Cooperative Society.
Verification of sown crop area is conducted via satellite and field inspection.
Funds are released via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly to the farmer's account.

name: Godhan Nyay Yojana (Suraji Gaon Yojana)
ministry: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare Department

shg_income.note: Women SHGs convert the procured dung into vermicompost and earn a direct dividend of ₹8 per kg of vermicompost sold.

effective_interest_rate_note: This is an income guarantee scheme. The state procures cow dung at ₹2 per kg and cow urine at ₹4 per liter directly from cattle rearers.
eligibility_human: Cattle rearers, farmers, and landless laborers in Chhattisgarh who collect and sell cow dung. Women SHGs involved in vermicompost production at Gauthans.
pros: Provides a guaranteed, daily cash income stream for landless laborers simply by collecting and selling cow dung.
Empowers rural women SHGs with a stable vermicompost manufacturing business model at zero capital cost.
cons: Payments can sometimes be delayed depending on the state's DBT disbursement cycles.
application_steps: Register as a cattle rearer/seller at the designated village Gauthan (livestock day-care center).
Bring cow dung to the Gauthan for weighing.
The Gauthan Samiti logs the weight in the official app.
Payment is credited directly to the seller's bank account every 15 days.

name: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Govt of Arunachal Pradesh
implementing_agency: State Bank of India / AP Rural Bank

zero_percent_interest.note: When stacked with the Central Govt's 3% PRI, this 4% state subvention reduces the effective interest rate of KCC loans to 0%.

effective_interest_rate_note: Borrowers pay 0% interest if the KCC crop loan (up to ₹3 Lakh) is repaid promptly.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Arunachal Pradesh availing short-term crop loans via the Kisan Credit Card (KCC) scheme.
pros: Makes agricultural working capital completely free (0% interest) for farmers in the state.
Involves Circle Officers to speed up the issuance of Land Possession Certificates (LPCs).
cons: Defaulting on the 1-year repayment deadline immediately voids the 4% state and 3% central subventions.
application_steps: Obtain an LPC from the local Circle Officer.
Apply for a short-term crop loan (KCC) at the nearest bank branch.
Repay the principal amount within the stipulated 12-month period.
Bank claims the subvention from the state government and nullifies the interest charge.

contact_info.helpline: Contact Local Bank Branch / Circle Officer

name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana
ministry: Energy and Petrochemicals Department, Govt of Gujarat
effective_interest_rate_note: A state-level infrastructure funding scheme. Farmers do not take a loan; they receive the benefit of 3-phase daytime electricity.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Gujarat holding a valid agricultural electricity connection.
pros: Provides reliable 3-phase power supply to farmers from 5 AM to 9 PM, eliminating hazardous night-time irrigation.
cons: Farmers cannot apply individually; benefits roll out automatically as the state upgrades high-tension transmission lines district by district.
application_steps: No individual application required.
State DISCOMs install new transmission lines and substations.
Feeder lines are switched to daytime scheduling, automatically benefiting connected farmers.

name: Mukhyamantri Gramin Kamgar Setu Yojana
ministry: Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Govt of MP

interest_subvention.note: The state government pays the entire interest amount on the ₹10,000 working capital loan.

effective_interest_rate_note: 100% interest subvention provided by the State Government, rendering the micro-loan effectively interest-free.
eligibility_human: Rural street vendors, cycle rickshaw pullers, potters, weavers, and small roadside traders in Madhya Pradesh aged 18-55.
pros: Provides collateral-free, zero-interest working capital to the most informal rural sectors.
Fast-track approval directly linked to the Samagra ID system.
cons: Loan amount is strictly capped at ₹10,000.
Limited to 1-year repayment cycle.
application_steps: Register on the Kamgar Setu portal using Samagra ID and Aadhaar.
Gram Panchayat verifies the vendor's local residence and occupation.
Application is forwarded to the bank.
₹10,000 is disbursed directly to the bank account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
implementing_agency: State Renewable Energy Nodal Agencies / DISCOMs

hill_states_ner.note: Central Financial Assistance (CFA) is 50% and State subsidy is 30% for NER, Hilly States, and Islands, bringing the total subsidy to 80%.

effective_interest_rate_note: Direct capital subsidy of 30% from the Center and 30% from the State. Farmer contributes only 10% upfront and can take a bank loan for the remaining 30%.
eligibility_human: Individual farmers, Water User Associations, FPOs, and Primary Agriculture Credit Societies (PACS) cultivating in rural areas needing standalone solar agricultural pumps or grid-connected solar power plants.
pros: Provides massive 60% to 80% subsidy for installing solar pumps, ending reliance on costly diesel.
Allows farmers to sell surplus solar power back to the grid (DISCOM) for additional income.
cons: Heavy reliance on State Government fund releases to match the central grant.
application_steps: Register on the state renewable energy portal or PM-KUSUM portal.
Deposit the 10% farmer share to the designated agency.
Agency assigns an empanelled vendor to install the solar pump.
Subsidy is adjusted directly at the vendor backend; farmer does not wait for reimbursement.

name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
ministry: Rural Development Department, Govt of Jharkhand
effective_interest_rate_note: 100% grant covering wage labor and material cost under MGNREGA convergence.
eligibility_human: Rural families in Jharkhand owning unused wasteland or minimum 0.5 acres of fallow land. Elderly and widow-headed households are given high priority.
pros: Transforms unused barren land into fruit-bearing orchards (Mango, Guava, Lemon) at zero cost to the farmer.
Government covers 3 years of maintenance and labor wages.
cons: Labor wages are tied to MGNREGA payout cycles, which can occasionally experience delays.
application_steps: Apply through the village Gram Sabha or Rozgar Sevak.
Land is inspected and cleared for plantation.
