women_sc_st_ner.note: Women, SC, ST, NER, and aspirational district MSMEs receive 100% reimbursement for space rent and contingency costs (General category gets 80%).

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure reimbursement grant. No loan is involved.
eligibility_human: Udyam-registered Micro and Small Enterprises seeking to showcase their products in domestic/international trade fairs, exhibitions, and vendor development programs.

documents_required.name: Invoices of Space Rent / Stall Booking

pros: Refunds up to ₹1.5 Lakh for domestic trade fairs (booth space, travel, freight) making B2B marketing practically free for micro-units.
Subsidizes barcode registration, e-commerce onboarding, and packaging design costs.
cons: Strictly a reimbursement scheme; the MSME must spend the money out-of-pocket first.
application_steps: Apply online on the MSME PMS portal before participating in the trade fair.
Attend the event and retain all original invoices (rent, travel, GST bills).
Submit the reimbursement claim online within 30 days of the event's conclusion.
MSME-DFO verifies documents and transfers funds via DBT.

name: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana (AHVY)
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
effective_interest_rate_note: 100% central grant provided to implementing agencies/NGOs to develop handicraft clusters. No loan is involved.
eligibility_human: Handicraft artisans operating in clusters. Funding is routed through NGOs, Cooperatives, or State Handicraft Corporations to organize artisans into SHGs, provide design training, and build Common Facility Centers.
pros: Funds comprehensive interventions: base-line surveys, design workshops, and international marketing exhibitions.
Builds hard infrastructure (Common Facility Centers) up to ₹5 Crore per cluster.
cons: Individual artisans cannot apply directly for cash grants; they must be part of an NGO/Cooperative-led cluster.
application_steps: Implementing agency (NGO/Coop) submits a proposal on the DC Handicrafts portal.
State Level Committee screens and recommends the cluster.
DC Handicrafts sanctions the project and releases funds in phases (Survey, Design, Marketing, Infrastructure).
Artisans receive free training, raw materials, and toolkits as part of the intervention.

name: NSTFDC Term Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC)

women_rebate.note: Adivasi Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana (AMSY) under NSTFDC provides loans up to ₹2 Lakh at an ultra-low 4% interest specifically for ST women.

effective_interest_rate_note: Loans are provided at highly concessional rates: 6% p.a. for loans up to ₹5 Lakh, and 8% p.a. for loans up to ₹50 Lakh.
eligibility_human: Scheduled Tribe (ST) individuals with an annual family income up to ₹3 Lakh seeking to establish or expand a business. Applicant must not be a bank defaulter.
pros: Finances up to 90% of the project cost (NSTFDC share), requiring minimal promoter contribution.
Exceptional 10-year repayment window at sub-commercial interest rates.
cons: Applications must be routed through State Channelizing Agencies (like State Tribal Development Corporations), which can result in bureaucratic delays.
application_steps: Obtain application form from the local office of the State Tribal Finance Corporation (SCA).
Submit the DPR and requisite ST credentials.
SCA sanctions the loan, drawing funds from the central NSTFDC corpus.
Loan is disbursed to the beneficiary to execute the business.

name: Pushp Utpadan Yojana / Mukhya Mantri Pushp Kranti Yojana
ministry: Horticulture Department, Govt of Himachal Pradesh

greenhouse_infrastructure.note: Provides 85% financial assistance for setting up naturally ventilated polyhouses and shade net houses specifically for floriculture.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct capital grant to encourage floriculture (flower farming).
eligibility_human: Farmers in Himachal Pradesh holding agricultural land willing to cultivate high-value commercial flowers (carnations, lilium, gladiolus, roses).
pros: Extremely high 85% subsidy on expensive infrastructure like polyhouses.
Additionally provides 50% subsidy on buying planting material (seeds/bulbs) and refrigerated transport vans.
cons: Strict geographic feasibility restrictions based on altitude and climate zones.
application_steps: Apply through the block-level Horticulture Extension Officer.
Site inspection is conducted for technical feasibility.
Farmer deposits the 15% beneficiary share.
Department constructs the polyhouse through empanelled vendors.

name: Chief Minister Krishi Tractor Vitran Yojana
ministry: Agriculture Department, Govt of Jharkhand

shg_priority.note: Priority is given to Sakhi Mandals (SHGs), LAMPS, and PACS for distributing tractors and agricultural implements.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 50% direct capital subsidy to procure a tractor along with two agricultural implements.
eligibility_human: Farmer groups, Sakhi Mandals (Women SHGs), and cooperative societies (LAMPS/PACS) in Jharkhand. Individual farmers are currently not eligible.
pros: Promotes Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) by subsidizing half the cost of a tractor for rural women's groups.
The group can earn robust rental income by leasing the tractor to local farmers.
cons: Individual farmers cannot apply.
Group must raise the remaining 50% through a bank loan or internal corpus.
application_steps: The SHG submits a resolution to the Block Agriculture Officer.
District Level Committee screens and approves the beneficiary groups.
Group deposits 50% margin money via bank draft.
Tractor is delivered from state-empanelled manufacturers.

name: Kisan Sahay Yojana / Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Govt of Gujarat

damage_tiers.note: If crop loss is 33% to 60%, compensation is ₹20,000 per hectare. If crop loss exceeds 60%, compensation is ₹25,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 4 hectares).

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% direct cash compensation scheme for crop loss due to drought, unseasonal rain, or flood.
eligibility_human: All landholding farmers (including Forest Rights Act patta holders) in Gujarat whose crops have suffered at least 33% damage due to natural calamities.
pros: Zero premium required from the farmer (replaces PMFBY farmer premium).
All farmers are automatically covered.
Clear, fixed payout bands based on crop damage percentage.
cons: Payout is strictly capped at 4 hectares (approx 10 acres); larger farmers receive no additional compensation.
application_steps: State declares specific talukas/villages as calamity-affected.
Farmers in affected areas apply online via the dedicated portal at village e-Gram centers.
Revenue officials conduct physical damage surveys.
Compensation is paid directly via DBT.

name: Matsya Bhabishyat Yojana
ministry: Department of Fisheries, Govt of West Bengal

sc_st_women.note: SC, ST, and Women applicants receive 60% capital subsidy on aquaculture inputs and pond development.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct capital backend subsidy applied against term loans for fisheries infrastructure.
eligibility_human: Youth and fish farmers in West Bengal owning or leasing water bodies/ponds (min 0.1 hectare) for fish farming, biofloc, or ornamental fisheries.
pros: Provides up to 60% subsidy for marginalized groups.
Covers highly profitable urban/semi-urban models like Ornamental Fish rearing and Biofloc tanks.
cons: Requires formal bank loan sanction before the state releases the subsidy.
application_steps: Apply via Duare Sarkar camps or the Block Fishery Extension Officer.
Officer conducts a site feasibility inspection of the water body.
Beneficiary approaches bank for the loan component.
Subsidy is released post-sanction and kept in a reserve account.

name: Kamyaab Kisan Khushhaal Punjab (K3P)
ministry: Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Department, Govt of Punjab
effective_interest_rate_note: A direct capital subsidy on farm equipment (Direct Seeding of Rice machines, laser levelers) aimed at water conservation.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Punjab moving towards crop diversification (maize, cotton) or adopting water-saving technologies like DSR (Direct Seeding of Rice) to curb groundwater depletion.
pros: Provides up to 50% subsidy specifically on heavy machinery that reduces water usage and stubble burning.
Promotes custom hiring centers for FPOs.
cons: Limited budget allocation; subsidies are drawn through an online lottery system due to high demand.
application_steps: Register on the AgriMachineryPB portal.
Select the required machine and apply during the open window.
If selected in the computerized draw, purchase the machine from an approved vendor.
Agriculture officer physically verifies the machine; subsidy is credited via DBT.

name: Haryana Mukhyamantri Vyapari Kshatipurti Yojana
ministry: Finance Department, Govt of Haryana

turnover_slabs.note: Compensation is slab-based. Turnover up to ₹20L: max ₹5L compensation. Turnover ₹20L-₹50L: max ₹10L. Turnover ₹50L-₹1.5Cr: max ₹15L. Turnover ₹1.5Cr-₹2Cr: max ₹20L.

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure insurance/compensation grant for business loss due to natural calamities or fire. No premium paid by the trader.
eligibility_human: Small traders and MSMEs in Haryana with an annual turnover up to ₹2 Crore, whose stock/business premises suffer damage due to fire, flood, or natural disaster. Must be registered on the state portal.
pros: Provides state-funded insurance cover up to ₹20 Lakh for small traders against fire/theft/floods.
The trader does not pay any insurance premium; the state covers it.
cons: Strict requirement to report the incident and file the claim on the portal within a very short window (e.g., 72 hours).
application_steps: Trader registers business turnover status on the Haryana portal.
In event of disaster/fire, file FIR/Fire report immediately.
File claim on the Kshatipurti portal within the mandated timeframe.
Revenue committee assesses damage; compensation is released via DBT.

name: Assam Pig Fostering and Broiler Scheme
ministry: Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department, Govt of Assam
effective_interest_rate_note: A 50% capital subsidy for establishing micro piggery and poultry units.
eligibility_human: Unemployed youth, farmers, and SHGs in Assam setting up commercial pig breeding/fattening units or broiler poultry farms.
pros: Addresses high local meat demand by subsidizing 50% of the cost for high-yield crossbred pigs.
ALPCO provides buy-back arrangements for mature pigs.
cons: The beneficiary must arrange 50% of the funds upfront.
application_steps: Submit application to the local veterinary dispensary.
Officers conduct site inspection for shed readiness.
Beneficiary deposits 50% share.
Department supplies the piglets, feed, and vaccines directly.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Sathi Yojana
ministry: Agriculture Department, Govt of Rajasthan

accident_insurance.note: Provides ₹2 Lakh compensation in case of accidental death or permanent disability of a farmer while conducting agricultural work.

effective_interest_rate_note: A 100% state grant providing free seeds, bio-pesticides, and accidental insurance to farmers.
eligibility_human: Farmers, agricultural laborers, and Hamals (mandi workers) in Rajasthan. Includes free mini-kits for seeds and ₹2 lakh accidental death cover during farming operations.
pros: Provides crucial financial safety net (₹2 Lakh) for agricultural laborers who face high occupational hazards.
Distributes free high-yield seed mini-kits (Bajra, Mustard) to millions of farmers.
cons: Accidental death claims must be filed strictly within 6 months of the incident.
application_steps: For free seeds: Apply via e-Mitra or RajKisan portal during sowing season.
For insurance claim: Submit FIR, Postmortem, and Jan Aadhaar to the Mandi Samiti or Agriculture Office.
Verification by local committee; funds released via DBT.

name: State Fishery Development Scheme (Odisha)
ministry: Fisheries and Animal Resources Development Department

women_sc_st.note: SC, ST, and Women beneficiaries receive 60% subsidy for excavating new ponds or setting up biofloc units.

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure capital subsidy reducing the cost of pond excavation, inputs (seed/feed), and boat/net procurement.
eligibility_human: Fish farmers, unemployed youth, and SHGs in Odisha possessing own/leased land for pond excavation (min 0.2 ha) or marine fishermen buying nets/boats.
pros: Generous 60% subsidy for marginalized groups.
Fully digital application and inspection process via the SUGAM portal and 'Go-Sugam' mobile app.
cons: Subsidies are released in two or three phases strictly mapped to GPS-tagged construction progress.
application_steps: Apply online on the SUGAM portal.
Fishery officer conducts geo-tagged pre-site inspection.
Beneficiary completes pond excavation (self-funded or via bank loan).
Post-inspection, the subsidy is credited to the bank account.

name: Chhattisgarh Mukhyamantri E-Rickshaw Sahayata Yojana
ministry: Labour Department, Govt of Chhattisgarh
implementing_agency: Chhattisgarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board

women_workers.note: Specifically targets women registered as unorganized workers, providing ₹50,000 upfront grant to purchase an E-Rickshaw.

effective_interest_rate_note: A direct ₹50,000 grant reducing the down payment of the E-Rickshaw. Beneficiary finances the rest via bank loan.
eligibility_human: Women in Chhattisgarh aged 18 to 50 who are registered with the unorganized workers' welfare board or building/construction workers board.
pros: Provides ₹50,000 free margin money, making eco-friendly E-Rickshaws affordable for low-income women laborers.
Empowers women with a stable, independent daily income source.
cons: Restricted strictly to women currently registered in the state labor database.
application_steps: Obtain application from the District Labour Office.
Submit form with dealer quotation and driving credentials.
Labour officer verifies registration.
Grant is transferred directly to the E-Rickshaw dealership.

name: Tamil Nadu MSME Promotion of Energy Audit and Conservation of Energy (PEACE)
ministry: MSME Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu

audit_fee.note: 75% of the energy audit cost (up to ₹1 Lakh) is reimbursed. 50% of the cost of implementing the audit's green recommendations (up to ₹10 Lakh) is subsidized.

effective_interest_rate_note: A pure capital subsidy/reimbursement for making factories energy efficient.
eligibility_human: Existing manufacturing MSMEs in Tamil Nadu looking to conduct energy audits and upgrade machinery to energy-efficient variants.

documents_required.name: Energy Audit Report from BEE Certified Auditor

pros: Incentivizes MSMEs to lower their carbon footprint and reduce monthly power bills.
Up to ₹10 Lakh subsidy on installing variable frequency drives, efficient boilers, and solar water heaters.
cons: The audit must be conducted by a Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) certified auditor, which can be expensive upfront.
application_steps: Engage a BEE certified auditor to conduct the energy audit.
Implement the recommended energy-saving equipment.
Apply online on the MSME TN portal for reimbursement with bills and post-implementation audit report.
DIC verifies and credits the subsidy to the MSME bank account.

name: Himachal Pushp Kranti Yojana
ministry: Horticulture Department, Govt of Himachal Pradesh
effective_interest_rate_note: A direct capital grant reducing the cost of constructing polyhouses for flower cultivation.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Himachal Pradesh holding agricultural land willing to cultivate high-value commercial flowers.
pros: Extremely high 85% subsidy on expensive infrastructure like polyhouses.
Additionally provides 50% subsidy on buying planting material.
cons: Strict geographic feasibility restrictions based on altitude and climate zones.
application_steps: Apply through the block-level Horticulture Extension Officer.
Site inspection is conducted for technical feasibility.
Farmer deposits the 15% beneficiary share.
Department constructs the polyhouse through empanelled vendors.

name: Mukhyamantri Solar Pump Yojana
ministry: New and Renewable Energy Department, Govt of MP
effective_interest_rate_note: A 90% capital subsidy on the total cost of the solar pump. The farmer pays only the remaining 10%.
eligibility_human: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh currently using expensive diesel pumps, possessing temporary agricultural power connections (3 HP / 5 HP), or lacking access to the electricity grid entirely.
pros: Provides day-time, free energy for irrigation, entirely eliminating diesel/grid costs.
An incredible 90% subsidy covers pumps up to 7.5 HP.
cons: Initial registration requires a non-refundable ₹5,000 fee.
If the farmer already has a permanent grid electricity connection for irrigation, they are lower priority or ineligible.
application_steps: Login to cmsolarpump.mp.gov.in via Aadhaar e-KYC and Samagra ID.
Select the desired pump capacity (e.g., 5 HP DC Submersible) and verify land records.
Pay the initial ₹5,000 registration fee online.
Upon allotment, pay the remaining 10% beneficiary share. MPUVNL handles installation via empanelled vendors.

name: Godhan Nyay Yojana
ministry: Agriculture Development and Farmer Welfare Department

shg_income.note: Women SHGs convert the procured dung into vermicompost and earn a direct dividend of ₹8 per kg of vermicompost sold.

effective_interest_rate_note: This is an income guarantee scheme. The state procures cow dung at ₹2 per kg and cow urine at ₹4 per liter directly from cattle rearers.
eligibility_human: Cattle rearers, farmers, and landless laborers in Chhattisgarh who collect and sell cow dung. Women SHGs involved in vermicompost production at Gauthans.
pros: Provides a guaranteed, daily cash income stream for landless laborers simply by collecting and selling cow dung.
Empowers rural women SHGs with a stable vermicompost manufacturing business model at zero capital cost.
cons: Payments can sometimes be delayed depending on the state's DBT disbursement cycles.
application_steps: Register as a cattle rearer/seller at the designated village Gauthan (livestock day-care center).
Bring cow dung to the Gauthan for weighing.
The Gauthan Samiti logs the weight in the official app.
Payment is credited directly to the seller's bank account every 15 days.
